Members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]] had a native '''language''' that they spoke. In the [[Language/Legends|language]], the word ''[[Yentarr]]'' meant "unknown spirits" and was the name given to a [[Deity/Legends|deity]]-like being the Bosph believed in. The words ''[[ela b'Yentarr]]'' meant "the chosen of the unknown spirits" and was applied to individuals whom were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], which was called ''[[abo b'Yentarr]]'' meaning "power of the unknown spirits".<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bosph language was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement magazine series ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[May]] [[1997]]. The language was introduced in an article titled "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" written by [[Brian Smithson]].<ref name="AE" />
